summary.business_type: Health/Education (YMYL) — Free online self-assessment tools and educational content

robots.txt live version differs from source code deployment

No WebP/AVIF image optimization — all 16 images are JPG
Missing MedicalWebPage, HowTo, and ItemList schema opportunities

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Canonical URLs auto-generated on all pages
All 23 pages have unique titles and meta descriptions
Open Graph + Twitter Card meta on every page
Clean URL structure with trailingSlash: never
HTTPS enabled
Static HTML output — fully crawlable without JS rendering
Mobile responsive via Tailwind CSS

findings.title: Sitemap not serving site pages
findings.description: Live sitemap.xml only contains /lander URL. The 23 actual site pages are not listed. Source code generates sitemap-index.xml via @astrojs/sitemap but live deployment is out of sync.
findings.recommendation: Redeploy site from current source. Verify sitemap-index.xml contains all 23 URLs. Confirm robots.txt references correct absolute sitemap URL.

findings.title: robots.txt mismatch between source and live
findings.description: Source robots.txt has 'Sitemap: https://foodintolerancecheck.com/sitemap-index.xml' but live has 'Sitemap: /sitemap.xml' (relative URL, non-standard). Live also has 'LLM-Policy: /llms.txt' not in source.
findings.recommendation: Redeploy to sync source and live. Ensure robots.txt uses absolute sitemap URL.

findings.title: Google Fonts render-blocking
findings.description: Outfit font loaded via external stylesheet from Google Fonts with 5 weights (300-700). Adds network round-trip before first render despite preconnect hints.
findings.recommendation: Self-host Outfit font or use font-display: optional. Reduce to only needed weights.

findings.title: No Google Search Console
findings.description: Site has no analytics or search console integration. While privacy-friendly, there is no visibility into search performance.
findings.recommendation: Add Google Search Console verification (no tracking code needed, respects privacy policy).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Author attribution (Dr. Emily Carter, Registered Dietitian) on all content
Publication and modification dates on blog and guide content
References from reputable sources (NHS, BDA, NICE, AAAAI, Monash)
Medical disclaimers on all tool pages
Good readability — plain English, short paragraphs, tables
Comprehensive FAQ page with 6 Q&A pairs
Detailed About page with editorial standards

findings.title: Thin content on guide pages (YMYL risk)
findings.description: 6 pages have under 400 words: reading-test-results (~200), low-fodmap (~250), ibs-food-intolerance (~300), symptoms (~350), elimination-diet-planner (~250), test-guide (~400). YMYL health content requires comprehensive depth.
findings.recommendation: Expand thin pages to 800-1500 words with practical examples, detailed explanations, and internal links.

findings.title: Author has no verifiable online presence
findings.description: Dr. Emily Carter is listed as author with strong credentials but has no LinkedIn profile, professional registry listing, or verifiable online presence. This weakens E-E-A-T signals.
findings.recommendation: Create author profile on LinkedIn and relevant professional directories. Add author page with photo.

findings.title: Missing Tools link in main navigation
findings.description: Header navigation only links to Home, Guides, Symptoms, Blog, About. The Tools section (core feature with 7 pages) is not linked from the main nav.
findings.recommendation: Add /tools link to Header.astro navigation array.

findings.title: Limited internal linking
findings.description: Tool pages don't link to relevant guides, and guide pages could link more to tools. No 'Related Content' sections. Some pages are potential orphans (elimination-diet-planner, food-diary).
findings.recommendation: Add contextual cross-links between tools and guides. Add 'Related Content' section to each page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 23 pages have unique title tags (40-65 chars)
All 23 pages have unique meta descriptions (120-160 chars)
H1 present on every page
Proper heading hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3, no skips)
Canonical URLs on all pages
Brand suffix consistency on blog posts

findings.title: Tools section missing from header navigation
findings.description: The primary navigation omits the Tools index, which is the site's core feature set with 7 dedicated pages.
findings.recommendation: Add Tools link to navLinks array in Header.astro.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema on homepage
WebApplication schema on homepage (HealthApplication category)
Article schema auto-generated on blog and guide posts
BreadcrumbList schema on subpages
FAQPage schema on /faq with 6 Q&A pairs

findings.title: No MedicalWebPage schema on health content
findings.description: Health/YMYL content pages lack MedicalWebPage schema which signals content expertise and specialty to Google.
findings.recommendation: Add MedicalWebPage JSON-LD with about, reviewedBy, and specialty fields to health content pages.

findings.title: Article publisher missing logo object
findings.description: Article schema publisher has name and url but no logo ImageObject. Google recommends publisher.logo with ImageObject for rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add logo ImageObject to publisher in BaseLayout Article schema generation.

findings.title: No HowTo schema on step-by-step guides
findings.description: Elimination diet guide has 4 clear steps (Preparation, Elimination, Reintroduction, Personalisation) that qualify for HowTo rich results.

findings.title: No ItemList schema on listing pages
findings.description: Tools, guides, and blog index pages list items but lack ItemList schema for potential carousel rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList JSON-LD to /tools, /guides, and /blog listing pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static HTML output (Astro SSG) — near-instant TTFB
Minimal JavaScript — only tool-specific inline scripts
No heavy frameworks (React, Vue, Angular)
Tailwind CSS purged during build
All images have width/height attributes (CLS prevention)
Hero image uses loading=eager, others use loading=lazy
Preconnect hints for Google Fonts

findings.title: Google Fonts render-blocking resource
findings.description: Outfit font loaded via external stylesheet with 5 weights. Adds ~300ms to FCP despite preconnect hints and display=swap.
findings.recommendation: Self-host font files or use font-display: optional with system font fallback.

findings.title: No preload hints for hero image
findings.description: Homepage hero image (hero-healthy.jpg) is not preloaded, adding unnecessary delay to LCP.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel='preload' as='image' href='/images/hero-healthy.jpg'> to homepage head.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Clear, well-structured content with defined headings
Author attribution with medical credentials
FAQPage schema (high AI citation potential)
Medical disclaimers and evidence-based claims
Content cites reputable medical organisations

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Live robots.txt references LLM-Policy: /llms.txt but the file likely does not exist on the server.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/llms.txt with site description, key pages, content policies, and citation preferences.

findings.title: References not linked inline
findings.description: Blog posts list references at the end but do not hyperlink claims to source pages (NHS, BDA, etc.). AI systems prefer inline citations for verification.
findings.recommendation: Add hyperlinks to authoritative sources (NHS, BDA, NICE) directly within claim sentences.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 16 images have descriptive alt text
All images have explicit width=800 height=450 (CLS prevention)
Hero image correctly uses loading=eager
All other images use loading=lazy

findings.title: No WebP/AVIF format optimization
findings.description: All 16 images are JPG only. No WebP or AVIF alternatives. Astro's built-in image optimization (astro:assets) is not used.
findings.recommendation: Use Astro <Image> component for automatic WebP conversion. Potential 25-35% file size reduction.

findings.title: Uniform 800x450 dimensions not responsive
findings.description: All images use same 800x450 regardless of container size. Tool pages display at max 672px, blog at 768px. No srcset or responsive sizing.
findings.recommendation: Use Astro responsive image features or srcset for different viewport sizes.
